title: Valid Square
constraints: Each point is an array [x, y] of exactly two coordinates.
inputFormat: Implement validSquare(p1, p2, p3, p4). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return true if the four points form a square with positive side length; otherwise return false.

visuals.title: A square can be rotated

visuals.caption: All four sides have squared length 2, and both diagonals have squared length 4. The input points may appear in any order.
